Let $y_1 and y_2$ be two elements of $f(x)$ such that $\begin{aligned} \text{$ and $} y_1=y_2 \\ \text{ and } \Rightarrow \quad 3^{-x_1}=3^{-x_2} \Rightarrow x_1=x_2 \\ \text{ and } \end{aligned} Since, if two images are equal, then their elements are equal, therefore it is one-one function
